definitions.explanation: A pleasant, gentle warmth. Can refer to physical warmth or the figurative warmth of human kindness and affection.

examples.english: I felt the warmth of a hand.
A wooden house has a feeling of warmth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{温|ぬく}もり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれて→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧⟦{育|そだ}った→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧。
examples.english: I grew up wrapped in the warmth of my family.

notes:
{温|ぬく}もり conveys a gentle, comforting warmth — both physical and emotional. It is often used in sentimental or poetic contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {温|ぬく}もり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to feel warmth)
- {温|ぬく}もり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれる→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧ (to be enveloped in warmth)
- {温|ぬく}もり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧〜 (~ with warmth, warm and inviting ~)
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{温|ぬく}もり (human warmth)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{暖|あたた}かさ→暖かさ：21688_atatakasa⟧: warmth (more neutral, also used for temperature)
- {温|ぬく}もり: warmth (more emotional, intimate, poetic)
